topic.title: Typography & Styling Showcase
topic.shortdesc: This chapter demonstrates the professional typography and styling features available in dita2epub v1.3.

body.p: The first paragraph of a chapter can optionally display a decorative drop cap when the epub.drop.caps parameter is enabled. This enhances the visual appeal of the opening text in each chapter.

section.title: Did You Know?
section.p: EPUB 3.3 became a W3C Recommendation in May 2023, ensuring the format's continued evolution under open web standards governance.
